summary: Writes DAT text or table contents to .txt or .dat files, with append and explicit write controls for logging or export workflows.

key_params.name: file
key_params.note: Destination path for DAT text or table output

key_params.name: n
key_params.note: Manual index value available for numbered output filenames

key_params.name: write
key_params.note: Write the current DAT contents to disk

key_params.name: append
key_params.note: Append to an existing text file instead of replacing it

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: Edit/view file extension exposed to external editors

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: Append mode is for text output and keeps the file handle open; turn it off when rewriting complete files.
With Append off, writing replaces the target file, so generated tools need explicit user-safe destinations.
The N parameter is not automatically incremented by the operator.
With no input DAT, File Out DAT can be used with send-style text triggering, which is different from normal wired export.
key_concepts: Writes DAT contents to .dat or .txt files.
The N parameter supports manually incrementing numbered output filenames.
Write triggers the file save action.
Append mode appends to text output instead of replacing the file.
